profile.headline: Lead iOS Engineer | Passionate for Software Architecture | ♥️ Swift
profile.summary: Experienced mobile developer, focused on delivering high-quality applications and committed to fostering a supportive and collaborative environment. Proven track record in enhancing team potential through constructive feedback and improving development practices. Seeker of opportunities to improve product, architecture, performance and process.

positions.title: Gap year
positions.description: Took a planned sabbatical to pursue personal and professional development. During this time, I undertook part-time freelance work, where I am developing a small web application using the Django framework. This project required me to learn both the Python programming language and the Django framework from scratch, enhancing my skills in full-stack development. Additionally, I am currently working on a personal blog focused on iOS development, where I plan to share insights and tutorials based on my expertise in the field.

positions.title: Engineering Group Manager
positions.description:
Promoted into a Dev Manager role combining deep technical expertise in Mobile development with team leadership. Provided guidance and coaching to my teams on technical matters, agile practices, and created a culture of open communication and relentless improvement.
- Led and managed multiple scrum teams: Established well organized teams and coached them through Agile and XP practices. Ensured high- quality deliveries aligned with vehicle launches.
- Developed Talent: Mentored junior developers and new hires, fostering growth through structured feedback and support, enabling them to excel early in their careers.
- Modernized Mobile Codebase: Leveraged effective communication skills to coordinate the technical roadmap and strategy for codebase modernization and scalability, creating 2 reusable libraries to unify design language and facilitate vehicle communication protocols.
- Optimized DevOps: Streamlined CI/CD pipelines across multiple mobile apps, reducing reliance on senior developers for release activities and improving overall team productivity.
- Helped Define Product Features: Actively collaborated with Product management in defining backlog for my teams. Always with a positive attitude to changes in priority.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, iOS
positions.description:
Core developer in the re-architecture of the Owner Mobile application and advocate for best development practices. Increased the app quality and code reusability by embracing eXtreme Programming methodology. Scrum agile leader focused on working software and shippable increments.
- Spearheaded, designed, and led the development of a hybrid framework to integrate React Native features into both iOS and Android existing native applications, enabling multiple teams to iteratively migrate application features to React Native without affecting development of new features.
- Designed modular architecture to support feature development from multiple teams. Required a high level of attention to detail to ensure scalability, maintainability and great developer experience.
- Introduced modern iOS architecture MVVM using Reactive Cocoa for UI bindings that resulted in high reusability, reducing implementation time of companion CarPlay features by 50%.
- Continually improved automated CI/CD pipelines runtimes, closely monitored their running time, and invested time diagnosing and reducing bottlenecks on the unit test targets and cut running time by ~50%.
- Improved developer experience writing functional tests by implementing Page Object Model. Resulting in an increased code coverage and reduced development time.

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
Hired to contribute to the development of their mobile application that allows merchants to accept multiple payment types from their iPhones and iPads.
Technologies: Cocoa Touch, Objective-C, Jenkins CI
• Configured the infrastructure to run automated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to ensure fast action to unit tests failures.
• Created a command-line tool to extract localizable strings from Interface Builder files to optimize the localization process and collaboration with other teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Objective-C · Computer Science · Agile Methodologies · Jenkins · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · UIKit · Code Design

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer
positions.description: Joined to kickstart mobile development services on the company. As one of the first IOS Developers in the company, my responsibilities were to analyze, estimate, plan, implement and test new features to current and new mobile applications, for multiple clients.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · UIKit · Code Design · Objective-C · MVC

positions.title: 3D Game Developer
positions.description:
3D Game Developer

Functional Experience: My main role on these projects was porting games which includes research the target
devices capabilities in order to use the right tools and APIs as well as analyze the game requirements and features
to start the development. I worked with many mobile devices like iPhone, iPad, Palm PRE, Windows Mobile phones,
consoles like PSP and FreeBox and for MAC.
My first experience here was the creation of a new 3D game for iPhone, where I worked with graphics engines, sound
engines, game logic and also 2D menus.
I was in charge of porting the graphics engine (OpenGL to SCE Graphics Library) for a PSP game, and also of
the implementation of new algorithms (Rendering and Memory) as well as images manipulation to improve device
performance.
Also I was in charge of the translation of cg shaders into glsl shaders to let the game run on almost all graphics card
with OpenGL support for a MAC project.
Other tasks that I did were the implementation of sounds, leaderboards, Multilanguage and multiplayer.

Tools: Mainly Microsoft Visual Studio for editing and debugging code, graphics and sound engines, APIs
documentation, Tortoise SVN for code repository, different SDKs depending on the target devices, in some projects
I developed tools for making the process faster and automatic, game editors and resources compilation tools (from

positions.title: 2D Game Developer
positions.description:
Java, Brew and BlackBerry

Functional Experience: As a Java, Brew and BlackBerry developer, I worked with J2ME, Brew and RIM (for BB)
APIs. My main task was games porting from one device to many others but with different capabilities, including
the implementation of touch screen features, bug fixing, resizing games to fit the target device screen size, sound
implementation, etc.
The best part of my work here was that I have successfully translated a complete game written in Java to C++ for
Brew platform, the challenge of this port was the online features, meaning that we had to download content from a
server, and then use it on the game. This successful project brings me the opportunity to move forward and I was
promoted to develop for iPhone and start with the 3D development.

Tools: Mainly code editors (Notepad++, PSPad), Tortoise SVN for code repository, some resources compilation tools
(from Gameloft).

projects.title: PayAnywhere & phoneSwipe
projects.description:
PayAnywhere & phoneSwipe (iOS). Joined the project at 2012. 

Both are an update of the previous version that enhances and lets you accept and process credit card, cash payments and other payments types using your smartphone. Merchants will be satisfied to discover all the features added like Sale Processing, Inventory Management, Report Creations, User and Subusers, Automatic Syncing among others.

The app was developed using Apple technologies, it supports iOS 5 and later and is available for iPhone & iPad in English & Spanish languages.

Responsibilities:

- UI Custom Controls
- Star Printer Interaction
- Web Services
- Unit Testing
- Bug fixes

projects.title: PaymentEngine
projects.description:
PaymentEngine SDK allows third-party developers to include in their projects payment processing logic like PayAnywhere and phoneSwipe.

Responsibilities: 

- Update existing method implementation, add new ones too.
- Unit Testing.
